Otherwise free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights written manual. Pin = GIS camping point 439, at the NE corner of the gravel loop lot; fine. Not waterfront kept. Phone matches.
flags: CRITERIA / DROP CANDIDATE (parking-lot camping): the area page says 'This area is leased from the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers to provide access to the Pomme de Terre River. A boat ramp and parking lot are provided. Camping is allowed in the Northeast corner of the parking lot. Please note that vehicles should stay on the gravel.' The area is 44 acres; the GIS has one camping point (439) at the NE corner of the area's one lot (388). On imagery it is a gravel loop lot ~90 x 25 m in woods at the end of County Road 281 (gravel past the end of Route Y's pavement). A 23-ft rig fits, but the camping is a corner of a boat-ramp parking lot, not a campsite.
PIN: stored 37.98200,-93.31215 = GIS camping point 439, at the NE corner of the lot. Fine.
